Facts:
The appellant vide RTI application dated 07.02.2017 sought information on
four points as under:
1. Names of persons who had approved proposals for grant of back date
promotion after the retirement of the concerned officials to the executive and non-
executive cadres in fire discipline along with copies of promotion list and minutes
of the concerned DPC meeting(s) where such patently illegal proposals were
approved.
2. Whether any promotion had been granted in the Asst. Manger and
Manager Cadres to senior manager cadre of NAD wing along with names of the
officers who had thus been promoted.

3. Other related information.
The CPIO replied on 16.12.2017. The appellant was not satisfied with the
reply of the CPIO and filed first appeal on 23.03.2017. The First Appellate
Authority (FAA) disposed of the appeal by virtue of its order dated 19.04.2017.
Aggrieved with the non-supply of the desired information from the respondent
authority, the appellant filed second appeal under the provision of Section 19 of the
RTI Act before the Central Information Commission on 01.07.2017.
Grounds for Second Appeal
The CPIO did not provide the desired information.
Order
Appellant : Present
Respondent : Shri R.S. Jagpal,
Assistant General Manager cum CPIO,
Airport Authority of India
Delhi
During the hearing, the respondent CPIO submitted that they had provided
the requisite reply vide their letter dated 16.02.2017 and final reply on 05.05.2017
and the First Appellate Authority (FAA)’s order dated 19.04.2017. The replies
furnished to the appellant are just and proper and hence the case might be
dismissed.
The appellant contested reply furnished on point no. 4 of the above stated
RTI application only.
The appellant further submitted that he had not received the final reply dated
05.05.2017 from the respondent authority concerned in the present case.
The respondent PIO is directed to resend the reply dated 05.05.2017 within
07 days of the receipt of this order to the appellant by speed post keeping the postal
tracking number as record. The despatch details are to be submitted to the
Commission within 07 more days thereafter.

On perusal of the relevant case record, it was noted by the Commission that
the reply provided is just, proper and comprehensive and hence interference of the
Commission is not called for in the present case.
With the above observation/direction, the appeal is disposed of.
Copies of the order be sent to the concerned parties free of cost.
